subject: microbiology
title: Mycobacterium leprae and non tuberculous mycobacteria

steps.tx: **Mycobacterium leprae** (obligate intracellular, uncultivable, coolest site seeker transmitted by prolonged nasal droplet contact) poles by immunity: **tuberculoid** (Th1, paucibacillary, few well defined anaesthetic plaques with thickened ulnar or peroneal nerves, nerve abscess) versus **lepromatous** (Th2, multibacillary, **leonine facies** with **madarosis**, saddle nose, stocking glove numbness with trophic ulcers). Borderline states wobble between. **Slit skin smears** with bacterial and morphological indices stage load; nasal scrapings seed contacts. Armadillos and red squirrels host zoonotically.
steps.say: Few numb plaques with big nerves is tuberculoid. Leonine face with lost brows is lepromatous.

steps.tx: **Leprosy reactions** threaten nerves: **type 1 reversal** (Th1 upgrade after starting therapy, swollen lesions with acute neuritis) needs urgent **steroids** to save function, while **type 2 erythema nodosum leprosum** (immune complex, painful red nodules with fever, iritis and orchitis in lepromatous disease) needs steroids with **thalidomide or clofazimine** (pregnancy guarded). **MDT** is rifampicin plus dapsone for 6 months (paucibacillary) adding **clofazimine** for 12 months (multibacillary); single lesion gets ROM (rifampicin, ofloxacin, minocycline). Counselling outlasts pills as stigma disables.
steps.say: Starting therapy then nerves inflame is reversal: steroids now. Painful nodules with fever in lepromatous is ENL.

steps.tx: **Mycobacterium avium complex** (soil and water, AIDS with CD4 under 50 causing disseminated fever with anaemia, **azithromycin prophylaxis** below the threshold, treatment with macrolide plus ethambutol plus rifamycin) heads NTM disease. **M. marinum** (fish tank granuloma on hands) loves cool extremities with sporotrichoid spread; **M. abscessus** (post surgical wound infections, drug resistant, needs multidrug with surgery); **M. kansasii** (photochromogen yellowing in light, miners, cavitary like TB); **M. ulcerans** (Buruli ulcer, mycolactone). Pulmonary NTM (bronchiectasis, Lady Windermere) needs ATS criteria separating colonisation.
steps.say: Fish tank hand granuloma is marinum. CD4 under 50 with MAC needs azithromycin prophylaxis.

steps.tx: **Runyon grouping** by pigment and speed organises NTM: photochromogens (kansasii, marinum) colour after light, scotochromogens colour in dark, nonchromogens (MAC, ulcerans) stay pale, rapid growers (abscessus, fortuitum, chelonae) mature within a week. **Scrofula** (cervical nodes in children, usually MAC) is excised or treated with macrolide regimens unlike TB nodes needing full ATT. Aquarium workers wear gloves; surgical site clusters trigger tap water investigation.
steps.say: Light yellowed colonies are photochromogens. Childhood neck nodes needing excision are MAC scrofula.
